svg.title: Predicted 1H NMR integrals and FTIR of PE-EO-(HDI)4 and GE-EO-(HDI)3
svg.desc: Predicted proton NMR in CDCl3 with peaks a to i assigned and integrated per molecule for the commercial grades (PE-EO 15/4 EO/OH, Mn 797; GE-EO n 6-7, Mn 1000), starting polyols as dashed traces, and predicted ATR-FTIR with key bands.
svg.text: Predicted spectra and peak areas of the two NCO-terminated prepolymers
Shifts/bands: typical literature values for HDI-urethane-capped PEG polyols (prediction, not measured). Areas: from the commercial grades below.
Commercial inputs and predicted prepolymer data

*100 equiv. HDI per polyol molecule (HDI 168.2 g/mol); only 4 resp. 3 equiv. react, ~96-97 equiv. must be stripped. Theoretical NCO wt% = f x 42.02 / Mn(prepolymer) - compare with titration (ASTM D2572).
1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3) - predicted shifts and integrals
(the first CH2 is part of the core;
Predicted integrals per molecule (normalise to b = 8.00 for PE-EO-(HDI)4, b = 6.00 for GE-EO-(HDI)3)
= polyol H - OH + NH + 12 H per HDI
all O-CH2 of the EO units
EO length from the areas: EO per molecule = (∫c + ∫b) / 4 -> PE: (52 + 8)/4 = 15.0; GE: (∫(c+d) - 5 + 6)/4 = 20.6, i.e. n̄ = 3.75 and 6.87 per arm.
Complete capping: ∫b : ∫f = 1 : 1; for PE also ∫b : ∫d = 8 : 8. Each missing unit of b (2 H) is one uncapped arm (still HO-CH2 at 3.72).
Residual free HDI: mol HDI per mol prepolymer = (∫e - ∫f) / 4 (free HDI adds 4 H to e, nothing to f, a or b).
PE vs GE: only PE-EO-(HDI)4 shows the isolated core singlet d at 3.42; for GE-EO-(HDI)3 the 5 core H are inside the 3.44-3.76 envelope.

g.title: polyol O-H stretch - must vanish when every OH is capped
urethane N-H stretch (H-bonded), free N-H shoulder ~3440
isocyanate N=C=O asymmetric stretch (free HDI absorbs here too)
C-O-C ether stretch of the EO chains (strongest band)

svg.text: Key change: the broad O-H band (3450) disappears while N-H (3330), C=O (1718) and amide II (1530) appear.
Predicted band-area ratio: A(2270) / A(1100) scales with NCO : EO = 4 : 15 (PE) vs 3 : 20.6 (GE), so it should be about 1.8 x larger for PE-EO-(HDI)4.
Per gram: NCO 2.72 vs 1.99 mmol/g, EO 10.2 vs 13.7 mmol/g (PE vs GE) - the GE trace is drawn with these relative strengths.
Limitation: FTIR cannot tell end-capped NCO from leftover HDI (both 2270) - use NMR (∫e - ∫f) or NCO titration.
